sidecar_url_missing.message: RF-DETR sidecar URL is not configured and the RF-DETR Segmentation add-on was not found. Install/start the add-on or set Sidecar URL in integration options.

sidecar.title: RF-DETR sidecar
sidecar.description: Connect to your local RF-DETR segmentation sidecar.

data_description.sidecar_url: URL of the RF-DETR sidecar. Leave empty to auto-detect the RF-DETR Segmentation add-on via Supervisor (recommended on Home Assistant OS).

cameras.title: Cameras & detection
cameras.description: Choose cameras and which object classes should trigger analysis.

data_description.confidence_threshold: Minimum confidence to accept a detection (0.1 – 1.0)
data_description.detection_classes: Only these COCO classes pass the detection gate before AI analysis runs

ai_analysis.title: AI threat analysis
ai_analysis.description: Configure ChatGPT / AI Task analysis when a relevant object is detected.

data_description.ai_task_entity: e.g. ai_task.openai_ai_task — used for ChatGPT threat analysis
data_description.threat_analysis_prompt: Instructions sent to the AI. Include guidance to end with the threat phrase when something suspicious is found.
data_description.threat_phrase: Text the AI must include when a threat is detected (default: THREAT DETECTED)

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose when and how to notify after detection and AI analysis.

data_description.notify_service: Full service name, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone or telegram_bot.send_message
data_description.notify_on_threat: Notify when AI reports a threat (or on detection-only if AI is disabled)
data_description.notify_on_all_clear: Notify when AI runs but no threat phrase is found
